articles.title: Professional investors dumped 52K BTC worth of ETFs in Q1, filings show
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETF ownership shifted during the market downturn as hedge funds exited positions, while banks and long-term allocators continued building exposure.

articles.title: Israel’s tax authority ‘disappointed’ in voluntary crypto disclosures: Report
articles.snippet: After expecting billions of dollars worth of crypto holdings to be reported during a voluntary disclosure period, the country's tax office said only 58 filers took advantage of the procedure.
